payload.original: Customers could not complete checkout for 40 minutes on 7 November; payments timed out after the card form was submitted.
payload.title: Checkout page outage, 7 November

payload.question: Why did payment requests time out after the card form was submitted?

payload.mechanism: The new release opened a connection per request without releasing it, so the pool of 50 was used up within minutes and later requests timed out with 503.
payload.statement: The 13:58 deploy of checkout-api exhausted the database connection pool.
